claims.claim: On October 20 the Ohio Casino Control Commission warned licensees that supporting sports event contracts without a state sports gaming license could lead to denial, nonrenewal, suspension, or revocation, and ordered confirmation of compliance by October 30.
claims.episode_span: told licensed operators, suppliers, and applicants that providing services to companies offering sports event contracts in Ohio without a state sports gaming license raises suitability concerns
claims.source_title: The Gambling Wire: Ohio Warns Gaming Licensees Over Prediction Market Ties
claims.supporting_quote: The OCCC has ordered licensees to immediately cease supporting prediction market platforms that offer sports event contracts. They must confirm compliance by October 30.

claims.claim: Cease-and-desist letters dated October 2 went to ten prediction-market firms, including Polymarket, with a stop date of October 16.
claims.episode_span: cease-and-desist letters went on October 2 to Underdog, Gemini Titan, Coinbase, Prophet X, Novig, Robinhood, Polymarket, Plus500, Moomoo, and Webull
claims.source_title: Ohio: Licensees providing services to prediction markets may impact suitability
claims.supporting_quote: The OCCC ordered Underdog, Gemini Titan, Coinbase, Prophet X, Novig, Robinhood, Polymarket, Plus500, Moomoo, and Webull to cease offering sports event contracts in the state by October 16.

claims.claim: Polymarket US sued Ohio officials in federal court seeking injunctions and arguing CFTC exclusive jurisdiction and a Commerce Clause violation.
claims.episode_span: Polymarket US then sued Ohio’s attorney general and Casino Control Commission officials in federal court in the Southern District of Ohio
claims.source_title: Polymarket US Sues Ohio to Block Sports Contract Enforcement
claims.supporting_quote: Polymarket US sued Ohio's attorney general and officials of the Ohio Casino Control Commission in federal court in Ohio, seeking to block enforcement of state gambling laws against its sports event contracts.

claims.claim: Governor Mike DeWine told Attorney General Andy Wilson to begin lawsuits against the ten operators who had not complied.
claims.episode_span: Governor Mike DeWine has told Attorney General Andy Wilson to begin lawsuits against the ten operators who have not complied
claims.source_title: Ohio: Licensees providing services to prediction markets may impact suitability
claims.supporting_quote: Republican Governor Mike DeWine has reportedly told Ohio Attorney General Andy Wilson to begin filing lawsuits against the 10 prediction market operators who have yet to come into compliance with the cease-and-desist notices.

claims.claim: Utah sued Kalshi and Susquehanna in state court over the gambling ban, and a commentator said market makers were served.
claims.episode_span: Utah has sued Kalshi in state court over the state’s gambling ban
claims.source_title: Utah Sues Kalshi, Susquehanna in State Court Over Gambling Ban
claims.supporting_quote: Utah Sues Kalshi, Susquehanna in State Court Over Gambling Ban

claims.claim: FanDuel’s Cory Fox told lawmakers about thirty Cameo videos over two years and a FanDuel Predicts VIP trial from September 15 for fewer than sixty customers.
claims.episode_span: FanDuel executive Cory Fox said about thirty Cameo videos featuring athletes or entertainers went to VIP customers over two years
claims.source_title: The Gambling Wire: Ohio Warns Gaming Licensees Over Prediction Market Ties
claims.supporting_quote: FanDuel executive Cory Fox confirmed that approximately 30 Cameo videos featuring athletes or entertainers were sent to VIP customers over a two-year period.

claims.claim: JD Supra reports the CFTC issued an interim final rule and a proposed rule on the scope of the swap definition.
claims.episode_span: the Commodity Futures Trading Commission has issued an interim final rule and a proposed rule on the scope of the swap definition
claims.source_title: CFTC Issues Interim Final Rule and Proposed Rule on the Scope of the Swap Definition
claims.supporting_quote: CFTC Issues Interim Final Rule and Proposed Rule on the Scope of the Swap Definition

claims.claim: An arXiv paper models prediction markets as Bayesian inverse problems in which price increments conditional on volume come from a latent mixture of trader types.
claims.episode_span: Conditional on volume, each price increment is drawn from a latent mixture of trader types.
claims.source_title: Prediction Markets as Bayesian Inverse Problems
claims.supporting_quote: We introduce a mechanism-agnostic observation model in log-odds space in which price increments conditional on volume arise from a latent mixture of trader types.

claims.claim: A Mathematical Finance paper finds trading volume approximately follows a Gaussian mean-reverting diffusion and increases with depth, volatility, and risk aversion.
claims.episode_span: Trading volume in that model approximately follows a Gaussian, mean-reverting diffusion, and it increases with depth, with volatility, and with risk aversion.
claims.supporting_quote: Trading volume approximately follows a Gaussian, mean‐reverting diffusion, and increases with depth, volatility, and risk aversion.
